english.title: Cause use of a motor vehicle emitting smoke / vapour / grit / oil

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: ROAD VEHICLES CONSTRUCTION AND USE REGULATIONS 1986

english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) caused **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) to use on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), from which

(A)_[smoke was]_
(B)_[visible vapour was]_
(C)_[grit was]_
(D)_[sparks were]_
(E)_[ashes were]_
(F)_[cinders were]_
(G)_[an oily substance was]_

emitted, when that emission caused or was likely to cause damage to property or injury or danger to any person who was or who might reasonably have been expected to be on the road.
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 61(5) of the Road Vehicles (Construction and Use) Regulations 1986, section 42 of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
caused use of on a road a vehicle which emitted smoke/vapour/grit/sparks/ashes/cinders/oily substance
which caused/was likely to cause damage to property/injury/danger any person might reasonably have
been expected to be on the road

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Statement of Facts procedure applies - see end of document for wording.
(ii) See also offence wordings: H174 and H182.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level four on the standard scale if in respect of goods vehicle or vehicle adapted to carry more than eight passengers.
A fine not exceeding level three on the standard scale in any other case.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
